t: Creating a New Position in a Company: Steps, Tips & Mistakes
s: March 10, 2023 - When creating a new position within a company, you need to outline the responsibilities of the job without encroaching on anyone’s turf. This could prevent the new role from materializing if existing workers feel threatened. Instead, focus on defining the new role so that it’s complementary to the current workforce. Convincing current workers that this new role is auxiliary in nature is an essential part of getting every team member’s buy-in.
